answer_1.quote: In this work, we cast all IE tasks as text generation and model the UIE system in a text-to-structure framework.
answer_1.outputs: The output text y is a unified Structured Extraction Language (SEL) that describes how the structural elements organize into the target structure, which can be represented as "{Spot Name: Info Span, (Asso Name: Info Span) (Asso Name: Info Span)}".

answer_2.quote: For the evaluation of IE performance, we use the widely adopted span-based offset Micro-F1 as the primary metric following previous work.
